description: This Java class defines an immutable date range with utility methods for date comparisons, duration calculation, and range intersection, primarily for backward compatibility with newer ComparableRange<Date> implementations.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: An immutable range of dates with methods for range operations and conversions.

methods.name: durationInMillis
methods.description: Returns the duration of the date range in milliseconds.

methods.name: endStamp
methods.description: Returns the end date of the range as a Timestamp.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the range.

methods.name: intersectsRange
methods.description: Checks if a given start and end date or another DateRange intersect with this range.

methods.name: startStamp
methods.description: Returns the start date of the range as a Timestamp.
